title: beyeria sulcata var. brevipes

It is a shrub that is native to Western Australia and is valued for its traditional uses in medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and triterpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
